profile.selected: Post-2026-07 normal F2P journey; reference facts frozen by sources.json, not by a client jar's age.
profile.historical_identity: osrs-240-cache-2695 from first-slice-sources.json is historical, not a retrieval prerequisite.
required_features: Learning the Ropes tracking and 1 QP
profile.material_choice: Prefer a matching current runtime/cache. If only an older client is usable, keep these behavior contracts and explicitly record missing client UI/data as a version mismatch; an old client does not silently authorize historical tutorial mechanics or 23 skills.

evidence_classes.verified_reference: Explicit fact in a retrieved, pinned source; NOT an observed live-server result and NOT automatic wiki authority.
evidence_classes.inference: A stated derivation/translation of source facts; not verified behavior.
evidence_classes.assumption: A reversible provisional choice needed to make a bounded contract actionable.
evidence_classes.engineering_contract: Project-required authority/persistence/transaction behavior, not a claim about OSRS internals.
evidence_classes.adaptation: A deliberate departure requiring the relevant approval. None are approved by these documents.

variant_resolutions.choice: Current Learning the Ropes transcript, not remembered pre-quest Tutorial Island.
deltas: no mandatory music/emote/friends/ignore lesson in current transcript
5 initial rune pairs, 50 initial arrows versus standardized departure kit
chicken cast completes quest before authorized Home Teleport

variant_resolutions.choice: Tin is the prompted first ore; either order can satisfy possession of both after real mining.
variant_resolutions.reason: Mining messages substitute tin/copper symmetrically. Never grant the second ore or assume clicking a rock succeeded.

variant_resolutions.choice: A valid resolved Wind Strike on the tutorial chicken is required; a chicken kill is not. A splash counts provisionally.
variant_resolutions.reason: Transcript says after casting, not after damaging/killing. Splash completion is inferred, not independently captured.

variant_resolutions.choice: 1 QP + 300 Cooking XP + range permission only; no invented money, ingredients or cake-making step.
First item-losing death, not necessarily first zero-HP event, triggers the forced Death tutorial. All three optional-looking topics must be covered before exit.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Pre-dialogue inventory/equipment are empty; seed the 25-coin bank entitlement exactly once before its first visible opening. Clothing is appearance, not equipment. Use the documented base 400 bank spaces provisionally; exact fresh-account identity-provider/security bonus mapping is not observed.
assumptions.reason: The transcript calls the net the first given item; the quest guide explicitly shows 25 bank coins at first opening, but neither is a fresh-account dump. Lazy versus creation-time bank seeding is unobservable before access.
assumptions.reversal: Replace defaults from an authorized fresh-account state capture; keep already acknowledged ownership changes.

assumptions.chosen_policy: If base level is already 3, award zero tutorial XP. Otherwise award normal tenths, capped below the level-4 threshold (2759 tenths). HP awards are always zero on the island.
assumptions.reason: Sources specify level 3, not an exact XP total. This deliberately does not invent a hard cap of 174.0 XP; a final ordinary action can pass 174.0 without reaching level 4.
assumptions.reversal: Measure boundary actions; change this policy without changing prior earned XP or tutorial stage.

assumptions.chosen_policy: The owning instructor returns one missing net/axe/tinderbox/pickaxe/dagger as specified in recovery handlers, only after its original lesson unlocked it and while still on Tutorial Island.
assumptions.reason: Hammer, Chef ingredients, sword/shield, bow/arrows and rune replacements are explicit. Other lost-tool branches are not in the transcript. Prefer re-gathering/re-smithing a lost dagger; instructor replacement is the last recoverability fallback.
assumptions.reversal: Replace only missing-tool handlers after a source capture; never blanket-grant a starter kit to advance a stage.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Undocumented multi-item instructor grants are all-or-none; explicit sword/shield and bow/arrows grants remain sequential and partial.
assumptions.reason: Transcript explicitly permits a sword or bow alone in one free slot. It does not describe every survival/Chef/rune overflow branch.
assumptions.reversal: Observe individual overflow cases. Preserve the explicit partial branches regardless.

assumptions.chosen_policy: On successful authorized Home Teleport, replace tutorial-carried/equipped possessions with the 18-kind standard kit in inventory, clear tutorial bank contents, then set bank coins to 25. Preserve skills, quest point and completed tutorial flags. Commit once.
assumptions.reason: Sources say gathered items are lost and list standard provisions, but do not prove equipment placement, bank-deposit retention, withdrawn coins, duplicate tools or exact reconciliation. This is a reversible provisional normalization, NOT an observed inventory dump.
assumptions.reversal: Capture departure after deposits/drops/withdrawal and with equipped bow; swap reconciliation policy and migrate tutorial-owned provenance, not ordinary mainland possessions.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Keep the documented mainland confirmation and normal-account/Ironman-information choices; an omitted brand-new dialogue span is explanatory, not a grant or skill gate.
assumptions.reason: The current transcript explicitly marks missing text, but guide and remaining transcript agree on Home Teleport and arrival. No full dialogue reproduction is claimed.
assumptions.reversal: Replace the paraphrased missing span from approved reference dialogue; retain actual spell completion.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Track onboarding internally from appearance; Learning the Ropes journal status changes to in_progress on first Quest Guide dialogue, and to completed on the first valid chicken Wind Strike resolution.
assumptions.reason: Quest details name the Quest Guide as start. Exact hidden varp/journal initialization is not provided; the conversion to a tracked quest and the completion condition are explicit.
assumptions.reversal: Bind hidden progress/journal values when extracted or captured; do not use remembered historical varp numbers.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Use the ordinary shared range-cooking roll. A resolved bread attempt may advance, including a burn; never boost success secretly.
assumptions.reason: The current transcript shows first bread success and later burned bread allowing exit. The older guide says bread cannot burn before an obsolete music step. Whether current first-bread success is guaranteed remains unverified.
assumptions.reversal: If a current source demonstrates a first-attempt guarantee, add that explicit source-defined override and change only its fixture.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Mixing flour and water leaves an empty pot and bucket plus dough: net +1 inventory slot. Reject before mutation if that extra slot cannot fit.
assumptions.reason: Recipe pages list the dough output but omit container byproducts. Returning these containers is an inference from ordinary Cooking container behavior, not a verified recipe-output capture.
assumptions.reversal: Capture mixing with 27 and 28 slots used; adjust byproducts without changing the flour/water ingredient requirements.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Store run energy in 0..10000 units. Apply the published post-2025 drain expression then floor its final result once; regenerate floor(Agility/10)+15 units on eligible non-running ticks.
assumptions.reason: Energy page is under construction and flags exact drain rounding/tick boundaries as needing confirmation. The old pre-2025 drain formula is not acceptable.
assumptions.reversal: Resolve rounding from a dated controlled source run; keep weight and agility inputs explicit.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Use the published crowdsourced skilling parameters low=64, high=512 for normal logs, with the shared success function. No guaranteed instant lighting.
assumptions.reason: Firemaking explicitly describes this as a belief and carries a citation-needed warning. It is not labeled verified here.
assumptions.reversal: Replace parameters with source-server evidence; the rest of the fire lifecycle and 40 XP remain independently usable.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Use normal-tree respawn 60..100 ticks and fire lifetime 100..199 ticks, uniformly. Firelighting retries consume 4 ticks. First gathering-roll phase is one full cycle after action acceptance.
assumptions.reason: Tree prose cites 36-60 seconds but its infobox differs. Fire developer quote gives 60-119 seconds, without a tick distribution. Action-length table gives steady cadence, not every initial/retry phase. These chosen integer schedules are inferences, not measured boundaries.
assumptions.reversal: Bind captured initial/retry phases and distributions; do not change XP or guaranteed tree depletion.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Clamp maximum accuracy/defence rolls to at least zero before inclusive random rolls. This affects Tutorial Island rats' -100 defence bonuses.
assumptions.reason: Rat stats explicitly contain -100 defence, but the wiki's simplified positive-roll hit-chance formula cannot directly handle negative maxima. The clamp is a labeled implementation assumption.
assumptions.reversal: Resolve negative-roll handling from a trusted current combat calculation/source test; positive-roll vectors remain valid.

assumptions.chosen_policy: For the published 1.33-XP-per-damage terms, use floor(40*credited_damage/3) tenths per hit. Cap credited damage to HP actually removed. Do not round each point separately.
assumptions.reason: Combat Options publishes 1.33 and Experience documents tenths/flooring, but they do not distinguish exact 4/3 from decimal 1.33 at three damage or every overkill case.
assumptions.reversal: Capture 1/2/3-damage and overkill XP. Retain exact fixed-point storage and source XP family selection.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Use the Shop article's linear stock-delta pricing for overstock as well as understock, with explicit bounds; use integer base item values, not rounded displayed prices as inputs.
assumptions.reason: The wiki calculator's overstock buy branch divides instead of subtracting and can disagree with the Shop article's worked example. Understock/default starter prices do not require resolving this conflict.
assumptions.reversal: Capture a known value>=100 item at surplus stock; replace only overstock pricing. Do not report it as verified.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Choose the ordinary unarmed level-2 Lumbridge goblin, primary 128-weight table 1. In the F2P profile, member-only table results become no primary item; tertiary rolls stay separately represented. The newly listed common energy-potion drops have no usable weights and remain an explicit unresolved supplement, not a made-up probability.
assumptions.reason: Current table's numeric weights sum to 128 before three unweighted energy-potion rows. Some level-2 variants use table 2. Exact selected spawn/table and conditional potion logic must be bound; guaranteed bones and listed weights are useful independently.
assumptions.reversal: Verify chosen source spawn and the potion-drop condition. Never substitute a guaranteed coin reward or pretend bones-only is the full drop table.

assumptions.chosen_policy: For equal source-provided per-unit kept-on-death values, use original carried/equipment slot order as a stable tie-breaker; protect individual units, not an entire arbitrary stack.
assumptions.reason: The source defines three valuable items and value ranking, not every equal-value stack/slot tie. The fixture values are synthetic reference inputs, not GE observations.
assumptions.reversal: Bind the exact tie/stack behavior from Items Kept on Death source output. Do not use total stack price as a shortcut.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Track the ordinary mill hopper and shared-across-windmills flour count per character. Reject grain loading/processing when it would exceed the 30-flour capacity; do not lose grain silently.
assumptions.reason: The flour source states sharing between mills, not players. Hopper capacity one is explicit; account ownership, overflow and disconnect timing are not fully documented.
assumptions.reversal: Capture two-character ownership and full-bin controls. Keep the three-floor route and material conservation.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Journal 'held' means currently carried, unnoted ingredients; delivered takes precedence. Banked/ground/lost items do not satisfy turn-in guards.
assumptions.reason: Journal differentiates found and delivered, but does not explicitly describe its bank visibility or what it displays after losing a previously found ingredient. Actual turn-ins must own usable items.
assumptions.reversal: Adjust only journal projection if source uses broader ownership; never allow remote bank consumption.

assumptions.chosen_policy: Run starts off, Logout remains usable, ordinary music/emote controls are not mandatory progress tasks. Other lesson tabs unlock at their documented step.
assumptions.reason: No fresh-account UI/settings dump exists. The current detailed transcript lacks old music/emote/friends lessons; treating their absence as a modern variant choice is stronger than reintroducing obsolete mandatory tasks.
assumptions.reversal: Bind actual default settings and optional-control visibility to current client captures; do not remove required documented unlocks.

external_bindings.required: Actual reachable tiles, floors, collision/LOS flags, gates/ladders/stairs, region closure and initial/arrival cameras; wiki markers are not certified placements.
Numeric tutorial progress/varbits and interface IDs if source client wiring needs them. Semantic stages do not depend on guessed numbers.
Current attack-animation launch/hit/projectile travel offsets and range/LOS mapping; do not replace with zero-delay hits.
Pinned effective per-unit GE/alchemy values for the chosen content. Fixture values are inputs, not a current market snapshot.

acceptance.note: This task supplies bounded source contracts and validates their internal consistency only. Separate Section 30 gates remain.
